title: Version 1.3.38 for VSCode
description: Continue released version 1.3.38 for VSCode extension featuring config.yaml improvements, session history filtering by workspace directory, and .continue/configs support. Includes dependency updates and pre-release builds for multiple platforms including Alpine Linux, macOS ARM64, and other architectures.
